title: Northgate Tire Center Work Order Pricing — Flat Repair Bundle Rates
content:
# Flat repair bundle rates

**Note.** A Northgate Tire Center flat repair charge carries a bundle rate read from the rotation charge booked on the package with the same service date as the repair (the most recent flat repair entry recorded on the package) and from the remaining tread measured on the repaired tire:

| Rotation charge booked on the package with the repair's service date | Tread measured on the repaired tire | Bundle rate |
|---|---|---|
| above zero | 4/32 inch or more | 0.5 |
| above zero | below 4/32 inch | 0.75 |
| none above zero on that date | any | 1 — the full rate |

**When the charge is fixed.** The flat repair charge for a work order is fixed only after the rotation logged on that same work order carries its rotation charge on the package. In other words, while a rotation logged on the repair's work order does not yet carry its rotation charge on the package, the flat repair charge for that work order is not fixed.

**How the rate acts.** The flat repair charge is multiplied by the bundle rate. The rate acts on the unrounded charge, and the charge is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Repair dated | Rotation charge on the package dated the same day | Tread on the repaired tire | Rate | A $20.00 charge before this rate becomes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-02 | $19.99 | 6/32 | 0.5 | $10.00 |
| 2026-05-02 | $19.99 | 3/32 | 0.75 | $15.00 |
| 2026-05-02 | $0.00 | 6/32 | 1 | $20.00 |
| 2026-05-02 | none; the only rotation charge is dated 2026-04-30 | 6/32 | 1 | $20.00 |

A tread of exactly 4/32 inch counts as 4/32 or more.
